verdict.rationale: Superset documents agent status indicators: running agents appear inline on the workspace item, and you are notified when an agent finishes or is waiting for input. It also lets you monitor many concurrent agent sessions from one dashboard, with live terminals in each workspace, and a power user reports running 40-50 sessions without losing track. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a live activity/output stream beyond embedded terminals, and independent hands-on corroboration of the status indicators specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, I can watch what a running agent is doing in real time, including its current status

citations.quote: Running agents and open ports appear inline on the workspace item
Finished / waiting for input: get notified when an agent finishes or pauses for your input.
monitor many concurrent agent sessions from one dashboard
Run Claude Code, Codex, or another CLI agent with terminals, code review, and browser previews in one workspace.
